import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter out derived features as they're less reliable
    non_derived_mask = [t != 'derived' for t in feats.types]
    ids = [feats.ids[i] for i in range(len(feats.ids)) if non_derived_mask[i]]
    types = [feats.types[i] for i in range(len(feats.types)) if non_derived_mask[i]]
    
    # Get indices of non-derived features
    cols = [feats.column(fid) for fid in ids]
    
    # Compute correlations to identify near-duplicates
    X = feats.x[:, cols]
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(X.T)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(j)
    
    # Remove near-duplicates
    filtered_ids = [ids[i] for i in range(len(ids)) if i not in to_remove]
    filtered_cols = [cols[i] for i in range(len(cols)) if i not in to_remove]
    
    # Calculate effect sizes using Welch's t-test
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(filtered_ids):
        col_idx = filtered_cols[i]
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        group1 = x[y == 1]
        group0 = x[y == 0]
        if len(group1) > 0 and len(group0) > 0:
            t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(group1, group0, equal_var=False)
            effect_sizes.append((abs(t_stat), fid))
        else:
            effect_sizes.append((0, fid))
    
    # Sort by effect size
    effect_sizes.sort(reverse=True)
    
    # Select top candidates for drivers (max 3 to keep model small)
    drivers = [fid for _, fid in effect_sizes[:3]]
    
    # For joint modeling, consider products of top 2 features
    products = []
    columns = filtered_ids
    
    # Add products between top 2 features only
    if len(drivers) >= 2:
        products.append((drivers[0], drivers[1]))
    
    # Create weighted score from top features
    loadings = {}
    for i, (effect_size, fid) in enumerate(effect_sizes[:2]):
        if effect_size > 0:
            loadings[fid] = effect_size
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
